name: refunds
summary: Agents refund charges on the payments API: an approver releases refunds above 100.00 USD, refunds above 500.00 USD are refused, and each run makes at most 10 refunds.
protects: every refund above 100.00 USD waits for an independent approver
no refund above 500.00 USD is made, approved or not
a run makes at most 10 refunds (the grant's counter)
the agent's grant covers creating and reading refunds only
excludes: refunds in currencies other than USD: both rules fail closed (CANNOT_AUTHORIZE) until you add rules for them
the total refunded per day or per customer: set a budget for that
whether a refund is justified: the approver decides from the charge and the reason the agent gives
refunds made outside PantherClaw (the payments dashboard, another integration, a person with the API key) are not seen or limited
the thresholds are examples: change them in a new policy version before relying on them

connections: a pc.mock-payments connection in enforce mode
a provider of the fact payments.charge.refundable
